description: Search, read, and cite across 152 libraries: 11 tools, 3 prompts, and a full-text resource.
name: io.github.The-40-Thieves/alexandria-mcp

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI key for routing (library_ask), synthesis (library_answer, library_research), and embeddings (library_ingest). Search and read tools work without it.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway base URL shared by every LLM role (router, synth, research, embeddings, rerank). Falls back to https://api.openai.com/v1.
environmentVariables.name: ALEXANDRIA_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key paired with ALEXANDRIA_BASE_URL. Falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: ALEXANDRIA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the core source (CORE, 57M+ open access papers). Free key from core.ac.uk/services/api.
environmentVariables.name: CORE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the courtlistener source (US federal and state court opinions). Free key from courtlistener.com.
environmentVariables.name: COURTLISTENER_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks govinfo (Congressional Record, Federal Register, US Code); also accepted by congress and regulations. Free key from api.data.gov.
environmentVariables.name: GOVINFO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the googlebooks source (40M+ books). Free key from the Google Cloud Console (Books API).
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks githubsearch and githubmcp (GitHub code search); optional for ghsa and openiti. Public-repo read scope is enough.
environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the nasaads source (NASA Astrophysics Data System). Free key from ui.adsabs.harvard.edu.
environmentVariables.name: NASA_ADS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the europeana source (50M+ European cultural heritage items). Free key from apis.europeana.eu.
environmentVariables.name: EUROPEANA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional for semanticscholar and library_recommend; raises the rate limit. Free key from semanticscholar.org/product/api.
environmentVariables.name: SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY

title: Alexandria
